headline: I build the reports, data pipelines and web apps that sit on top of big databases.
lede: At Comcast I work on daily reports that business teams rely on, written in Oracle PL/SQL, Java and CloverDX. Much of that work is making slow jobs fast and setting up alerts for when one fails. Before that I spent four years at Turn 14 Distribution building PHP and MySQL apps for a B2B e-commerce platform and a warehouse system.
